scope: Exported storage module only; browser integration is not covered
checks: Legacy migration separates preferences and session without modifying legacy
Empty migration keeps preference defaults absent and uses null session order
Two tabs merge only changed preference fields into latest preferences
Stale empty pagehide cannot erase the owned song or position
Explicit user takeover and clear retain current:null and empty queue
Automatic next song saves for owner and cannot reclaim after takeover
Position writes require both owner and the selected song
Old legacy writers cannot affect v2 reads or a newly opened v2 tab
Existing v2 records are not migrated or overwritten on store creation
Partial migration preserves the existing v2 record
Returned session and preferences cannot mutate adapter data
Failed and thrown writes report false without granting ownership or changing saved values
Failed migration retains only its initial snapshot and never reports a successful save
Preference API rejects playback keys and legacy-only motion writes
Unknown existing v2 fields cannot enter a preference save
